title: 第128章 朕就问你们帅不帅！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 萧棣看着唐逸正向他这边走来，一手压着绣春刀，一手负在身后。脚步从容，神态自如，而在他身后，火光冲天，飞沙走石，导致他此时看上去真如仙人临世，手段通天！萧棣回头看向炎文帝，眼神那是一个幽怨。父皇，你误我啊！本来计划是唐逸配合我的，因为你一句话，成为我配合唐逸了。不然，现在那个炮火中牛逼走来的人，就是我了。“他……他真的做到了？！”孔诗岚被这一幕吓得脸色煞白，但这时美眸却盯着唐逸，眼中充满震惊和震撼。在这一刻，她忽然发现以前有关唐逸的所有消息，似乎都是假的。说他是个一无是处的废物，结果他是名动京都的小诗仙。说他不会武功是锦衣卫败类，结果现在他一刀，横扫了整个暗京楼。他身上……到底还有多少秘密？唐音也被吓得脸色煞白，这时正躲在杜凌菲的怀里，但一双大眼睛却瞪得如铜铃。哼，就说哥哥是最厉害的，你们不相信。现在知道我哥哥的厉害了吧？杜凌菲微微抿着唇，俏脸上也带着震惊和震撼，她是知道一些真相的，自从唐逸知道自己上暗榜后，就开始捣鼓秘密武器。结果，就捣鼓出了一对黑色粉末，她还以为唐逸只是玩玩而已。却没想到，他竟然真造出来秘密武器，威力宛若雷神降世。“什么？这怎么可能？他怎么做到的？”使团那边，秦钰猛地站了起来，那近乎妖异的脸上难以再保持震惊，连声音都失控了。她很确信唐逸刚才挥出了一刀，没有半点真气，软绵绵的没有缚鸡之力。可是，他这一刀之下，暗京楼那边已经天崩地裂了！“这，这不可能，这绝不可能！”宇文封已经崩了起来，原本嚣张嘚瑟的脸，此时已经狰狞如厉鬼，震惊而惶恐。看着河对岸被炸得支离破碎惨叫连连，连想要逃离都被炸飞回去的暗京楼高手，宇文封只觉得天塌了！原本该看着暗京楼大杀四方，杀炎文帝屠大炎百官，再将唐逸的脑袋送到他的胯下当夜壶。可现在看到的却是唐逸一刀屠尽暗京楼！他北狄花百万两，向暗京楼买炎文帝的脑袋，却因为一个唐逸，他北狄的大计又完了。“唐逸，唐逸……”宇文封盯着缓步走来的唐逸，手死死攥成拳，眼中的杀意几乎都快化为了实质。该死的，坏本王大事，本王必定要你死无葬身之地，本王要杀你全家，让你万劫不复！而刚才瞧不起唐逸的那些东虞和北狄的高手，这时全都脸色煞白，都被这一幕给吓到了。“不，这不是真的，这不是真的！”“他怎么可能有这种本事，他一个废物，他怎么可能有这个本事？”颜霜玉和姜云娜看到这一幕都踉跄后退，脸上满是惊恐，彻底被唐逸吓破胆了。原本还指望暗京楼出手，替她们宰了唐逸，一雪前耻。却没想到暗京楼却反过来被唐逸摩擦了。当然，此时此刻最后悔最恐惧最难受的人，还有太子萧琮。看着唐逸走到萧棣的身边，和萧棣拳碰拳庆祝，他瞳孔陡缩，几乎坐都坐不稳，要从椅子滑落到地上了。“父皇……父皇没骗我……”太子脸色煞白，低声呢喃。之前，炎文帝告诉他，能收服唐逸，可以巩固他的太子之位。他不屑一顾，一个废物能对他提供什么帮助？他没有理会唐逸，反而大力支持唐画，却没想到唐画就是个没有本事的伪君子，而唐逸才是真正有本事的人。暗京楼，那可是荼毒了大炎数十年的邪恶门派，连父皇都拿他们没有办法。可现在暗京楼却被唐逸给摩擦了，一刀，灭掉了半个暗京楼的精锐。连暗京楼都不是对手，他一个太子，能是唐逸的对手吗？真惹急了他，这家伙一刀还不得将他的东宫给掀了？萧琮后悔了，早知道如此，该拉拢唐逸的，不该得罪他啊！而这时看着那剧烈的爆炸，宁川，苏狂，以及锦衣卫众人也都是目瞪口呆，脸色震惊而惊恐。刚才看到唐逸嘚瑟，他们只是觉得丢脸，怕别人嘲笑他们锦衣卫盛产傻子！可现在看着被炸得粉身碎骨的暗京楼高手，他们全都傻了，那爆炸声简直就像是扇在他们脸上的巴掌一样，那是一个响亮。原来，小丑从一开始，就是他们啊！“妈的，原来这两个家伙说的是真的，一切真在掌控之中。”宁川有些咬牙切齿，难怪之前这两个家伙这么自信，感情早就做好了局呢！混账，老子是你们老大，这么大的事情你们竟然不告诉我？怎么地？老子还会抢你们的功劳啊！苏狂和赵安等人看着暗京楼的惨状，却都在头皮发麻，脊背发凉。不知为何，他们总感觉唐逸是在立威啊！“陛……陛下，计划……计划还继续吗？”炎文帝的身边，陈貂寺声音也都磕巴了，也被这一幕吓得不轻。炎文帝还在震惊中，听到这话嘴角猛地抽了抽，计划？朕的计划是什么来着？哦，想起来了，朕的计划是将暗京楼引诱出来，全面围歼暗京楼。为此，他还特意组建密谍司，从天下各地招募精锐进行秘密训练，就是为了一举铲除暗京楼在这颗毒瘤。如今，三千密谍司就埋伏在沈园周围。可是现在这种情况，他辛辛苦苦培养出来的密谍司……似乎只能干一点收尾的工作了。炎文帝瞅向唐逸当时便抽了一口凉气，朕让你上去混个功劳，没让你把功劳都全占了啊！不过，占得好，哈哈哈……“好，哈哈，不愧是朕看中的人，不愧是朕的小诗仙，做得好！”炎文帝看着唐逸，直接竖起大拇指不吝夸赞：“这一刀，帅炸天了，哈哈，朕就问你们，朕的小诗仙这一刀，帅不帅？！”“帅！！”众人齐声附和，声动九霄。虽然很多人很不甘心，现在他们能怎么办？他们也很绝望啊！唐逸一刀灭了暗京楼精锐，能不帅吗？
content_en: Xiao Di looked at Tang Yizheng walking towards him, holding the Xiuchun Dao in one hand and holding the other behind his back.His steps were calm and his expression was calm, but behind him, the fire was soaring into the sky, and the sand and rocks were flying, making him look like an immortal who had come to this world, and his skills were all-powerful!Xiao Di turned back to look at Emperor Yanwen, his eyes filled with resentment.Father, you misled me!The original plan was for Tang Yi to cooperate with me, but because of your words, I became the one to cooperate with Tang Yi.Otherwise, I would be the awesome person coming out of the gunfire now."He...he really did it?!" Kong Shilan was so frightened by this scene that her face turned pale, but at this time, her beautiful eyes were staring at Tang Yi, her eyes full of shock and shock.At this moment, she suddenly discovered that all the previous news about Tang Yi seemed to be false.He was said to be a good-for-nothing good-for-nothing, but he turned out to be a famous poet in Kyoto.He was said to be a scum of Jinyiwei because he didn't know martial arts, but now he swept across the entire Anjing Tower with a single blow.How many secrets...are there in him?Tang Yin was also frightened and turned pale. At this time, she was hiding in Du Lingfei's arms, but her big eyes were as wide as bells.Humph, just say that my brother is the most powerful, but you don’t believe it.Now you know how powerful my brother is, right?Du Lingfei pursed her lips slightly, with shock and shock on her pretty face. She knew some of the truth. Ever since Tang Yi knew that she was on the secret list, she began to tinker with secret weapons.As a result, a pair of black powder came out. She thought Tang Yi was just playing.But he didn't expect that he actually created a secret weapon, which was as powerful as the God of Thunder."What? How is this possible? How did he do it?" On the other side of the mission, Qin Yu stood up suddenly. His almost monstrous face could no longer maintain the shock, and even his voice was out of control.She was very sure that Tang Yi had just swung a knife, which had no energy at all and was too soft to bind a chicken.However, under his sword, the Anjing Tower was shattered!"This, this is impossible, this is absolutely impossible!" Yu Wenfeng collapsed, and his originally arrogant and sullen face now became as ferocious as a ghost, shocked and frightened.Seeing the masters of the Anjing Tower on the other side of the river who were blown to pieces and screamed in agony, and who were blown back even when they tried to escape, Yu Wenfeng felt that the sky was falling!They were supposed to watch An Jing Tower massacre everyone, kill Emperor Yan Wen and massacre all officials of Yan Dynasty, and then send Tang Yi's head to his crotch as a chamber pot.But what I see now is Tang Yi slaughtering Anjing Tower with one sword!He spent a million taels in Beidi to buy Emperor Yanwen's head from Anjinglou, but because of Tang Yi, his Beidi plan came to an end."Tang Yi, Tang Yi..." Yu Wenfeng stared at Tang Yi, who was walking slowly, his hands tightly clenched into fists, and the killing intent in his eyes almost turned into reality.Damn it, if you ruin this king's important affairs, I will definitely kill you without a burial place. I will kill your whole family and make you irrecoverable!The masters from Dongyu and Beidi who had looked down on Tang Yi just now all turned pale and were frightened by this scene."No, this is not true, this is not true!" "How could he have this ability? He is a loser, how could he have this ability?" Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna staggered back when they saw this scene, their faces full of horror, and they were completely frightened by Tang Yi.They originally expected An Jinglou to take action and kill Tang Yi for them to avenge their previous shame.But he didn't expect An Jinglou to be rubbed by Tang Yi in turn.Of course, the person who regrets, fears and feels the most at this moment is the prince Xiao Cong.Seeing Tang Yi walk up to Xiao Di and fist-bump with Xiao Di in celebration, his pupils shrank sharply and he could hardly sit still, and was about to slip from his chair to the ground."Father...Father didn't lie to me..." The prince turned pale and murmured in a low voice.Before, Emperor Yanwen told him that if he could conquer Tang Yi, he could consolidate his position as prince.He dismissed it. How could a loser help him?He ignored Tang Yi and instead strongly supported Tang Hua, but he did not expect that Tang Hua was a hypocrite without ability, while Tang Yi was the truly capable person.Anjing Tower is an evil sect that has tortured Dayan for decades. Even his father can't do anything to them.But now Anjinglou was rubbed by Tang Yi, and half of Anjinglou's elite were wiped out with a single blow.Even Anjing Tower is no match for him. As a prince, can he be Tang Yi's rival?If he really pissed him off, how could this guy tear down his east palace with just one blow?Xiao Cong regretted it. If he had known this earlier, he should have won over Tang Yi instead of offending him!At this moment, looking at the violent explosion, Ning Chuan, Su Kuang, and everyone in Jin Yiwei were also stunned, with shocked and horrified expressions on their faces.When they saw Tang Yi's arrogance just now, they just felt embarrassed and were afraid that others would laugh at them. Jinyiwei is full of fools!But now they were all dumbfounded when they looked at the Anjing Tower masters who were blown to pieces. The explosion was like a slap on their face, it was so loud.It turns out that the clowns have been them from the beginning!"Damn, it turns out what these two guys said is true. Everything is really under control." Ning Chuan gritted his teeth. No wonder these two guys were so confident before and their relationship was already settled!Damn it, I'm your boss, why didn't you tell me such a big thing?How?I will still take your credit!Su Kuang, Zhao An and others looked at the tragic situation in Anjing Tower, but their scalps were numb and their spines were chilling.For some reason, they always felt that Tang Yi was trying to establish his authority!"Your Majesty... Your Majesty, the plan... the plan is still going on?" Beside Emperor Yan Wen, Chen Diao Si's voice also stuttered, and he was also frightened by this scene.Emperor Yanwen was still in shock. When he heard these words, the corners of his mouth twitched sharply. Plan?What is my plan?Oh, I remembered, my plan is to lure Anjing Tower out and completely encircle and annihilate Anjing Tower.To this end, he also specially formed a secret espionage department and recruited elites from all over the world for secret training, just to eradicate this cancer in the Anjing Tower in one fell swoop.Now, three thousand secret spies are ambushing around Shen Yuan.But under the current circumstances, the secret agent he had worked so hard to train...seems like he can only do some finishing work.Emperor Yan Wen took a deep breath when he looked at Tang Yi, I asked you to come up and take the credit, I didn't let you take all the credit!However, it's a good take, hahaha... "Okay, haha, you are worthy of being the person I like, my little poetry fairy, well done!" Emperor Yan Wen looked at Tang Yi and gave a thumbs up and praised: "This sword is so handsome. Haha, I want to ask you, is my little poetry fairy handsome with this sword?"
title_en: Chapter 128 I just want to ask you if you are handsome!
